FAQ

Common questions, answered.

How long does a typical bathroom or shower installation take?+

Most bathroom remodels take 2–4 weeks depending on scope, and shower-only projects typically take 1–2 weeks. We'll give you a specific timeline as part of your estimate.

Do you provide a written, itemized estimate?+

Yes. Every project starts with a detailed, itemized quote so you know exactly what's included before any work begins.

What's involved in waterproofing and shower preparation?+

Proper waterproofing — membrane, slope, and substrate prep — happens before a single tile is set. It's the unseen work that protects your home long after the project is finished.

Can you help me choose materials, or do I need to buy my own?+

Either works. We can source and recommend tile, stone, and finishes, or install materials you've already selected.

Do you handle floor and wall tile, or just showers and bathrooms?+

Both. We install floor and wall tile throughout the home — kitchens, entryways, patios, and living spaces — in addition to bathrooms and showers.

What areas do you serve?+

We serve the San Fernando Valley, Los Angeles, Beverly Hills, and the surrounding communities.
